descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Step into the world of Dino Quest VR, an adventure where exploration, survival, fossil hunting, and dinosaurs come to life around you.

Travel across mysterious islands filled with ancient ruins,
 hidden caves, dangerous jungles, and realistic dinosaur encounters. [media]
[media]
Use interactive VR tools to excavate fossils, solve environmental puzzles, unlock secrets, and survive terrifying predators in an immersive world built for virtual reality.
[media]
[media]
Whether you are carefully uncovering dinosaur bones, escaping a giant carnivore, or exploring forgotten research facilities, every moment is designed to make you feel inside a real dinosaur adventure.
